ModMetaData.name: Prepatcher (1.7)
ModMetaData.author: Zetrith, 1.7 port by Ren
ModMetaData.description:
Prepatcher updated for 1.7. All Zetrith's work, I just fixed what the new runtime broke.
Unsubscribe the original first. They share a mod id and you'll get errors with both.
Harmony isn't bundled anymore. Subscribe to Harmony and let it load above this.
Haven't tested it on a big modlist yet. Report anything broken here, not to Zetrith.
If he wants it down, or puts out his own 1.7 build, just say so and I'll remove it.
